soc-2021-10-24-sd-oak: Oakland Roots kept their USL Championship playoff hopes alive with a dramatic 4–3 win at San Diego Loyal in front of 4,982 fans at Torero Stadium. [[augustine-williams|Augustine Williams]] gave the hosts a 17th-minute lead after a cross from [[corey-hertzog|Corey Hertzog]], but an own goal by [[callum-montgomery|Callum Montgomery]] brought Oakland level before halftime.

Oakland took command after the break. [[jesus-enriquez|Jesus Enriquez]] struck in the 52nd minute, and [[akeem-o-connor-ward|Akeem O'Connor-Ward]] made it 3–1 seven minutes later. Williams scored his second in the 76th minute, and Hertzog's 86th-minute equalizer brought San Diego all the way back to 3–3. Hertzog's goal also moved him into second place on the USL's all-time scoring list at the time, with 73.

The late drama was not over. Oakland substitute [[tarek-morad|Tarek Morad]] was sent off in the 87th minute, leaving the visitors down to ten men. But San Diego goalkeeper Austin Guerrero conceded a stoppage-time penalty, and [[jeremy-bokila|Jeremy Bokila]] converted it to restore Oakland's lead. The Roots held on for a seven-goal thriller and three crucial points, while San Diego's hopes of hosting a first-round playoff match took a hit.
soc-2026-06-24-mar-hai: Morocco needed two comebacks before claiming a 4–2 victory over Haiti in their final 2026 World Cup group match in Atlanta. Haiti struck first in the 10th minute when a move involving [[jean-kevin-duverne|Jean-Kevin Duverne]] and [[lenny-joseph|Lenny Joseph]] ended with the ball deflecting off Morocco goalkeeper [[yassine-bounou|Yassine Bounou]] for an own goal. [[achraf-hakimi|Achraf Hakimi]] equalized in the 39th minute, but [[wilson-isidor|Wilson Isidor]] restored Haiti's lead four minutes later with a powerful strike from outside the penalty area.

Morocco responded before the interval: Hakimi set up [[ismael-saibari|Ismael Saibari]] in first-half stoppage time to make it 2–2. Saibari's goal was his third of the tournament, one in each group match. Haiti goalkeeper [[johny-placide|Johny Placide]] had kept Morocco at bay with several saves, and the teams remained level deep into the second half.

The decisive breakthrough came in the 78th minute, when substitute [[soufiane-rahimi|Soufiane Rahimi]] finished after a corner was not cleared. Rahimi then helped create an 89th-minute goal for fellow substitute [[gessime-yassine|Gessime Yassine]], sealing Morocco's 4–2 win. The result sent Morocco into the round of 32 as Group C runners-up, while Haiti departed after three defeats despite twice leading in this match.
soc-2026-08-29-nsh-cin: Nashville SC extended its remarkable 2026 MLS campaign with a 4–0 victory over FC Cincinnati at GEODIS Park. The opening breakthrough arrived in the 43rd minute, when [[sam-surridge|Sam Surridge]] headed in a cross from [[cristian-espinoza|Cristian Espinoza]], with [[andy-najar|Andy Najar]] helping create the move. Nashville went into halftime ahead 1–0 and never relinquished control of the scoreline.

[[hany-mukhtar|Hany Mukhtar]] doubled the advantage in the 54th minute, finishing a move involving [[elias-saad|Elias Saad]] and Surridge. Cincinnati generated chances of its own, but Nashville goalkeeper [[brian-schwake|Brian Schwake]] made six saves and preserved the shutout. Substitute [[bryan-acosta|Bryan Acosta]] added a third goal in the 90th minute from a Mukhtar free kick.

[[ahmed-qasem|Ahmed Qasem]] completed the scoring six minutes into stoppage time, assisted by [[reed-baker-whiting|Reed Baker-Whiting]] and [[shakur-mohammed|Shakur Mohammed]]. Four different Nashville players scored as the club reached 52 points through 22 matches, a new MLS record for the best start over that span, and stretched its winning streak to four.
